title: Growing older and staying connected
titleZh: 年岁增长，继续参与社区生活
summaryZh: 北爱尔兰就老年生活行动计划征求意见：住房、就业与社区活动如何帮助人们保持独立？
levelReason: 编辑估计A2：以具体生活领域和时间为主，使用短句与常见动词；独立生活、能源费用和公共征询等新词提供中文辅助。非官方分级。

sentences.text: On 9 November 2026, Northern Ireland’s Department for Communities asked the public for views on a new plan for older people.
sentences.zh: 2026年11月9日，北爱尔兰社区部就一项面向老年人的新计划向公众征求意见。

sentences.text: The plan aims to help people stay healthy, live independently and take part in community life.
sentences.zh: 这项计划旨在帮助人们保持健康、独立生活并参与社区生活。

sentences.text: It supports a wider Active Ageing Strategy, which now runs until 2032.
sentences.zh: 它为更广泛的《积极老龄化战略》提供支持，该战略现已延长至2032年。

sentences.text: Northern Ireland’s population is getting older, so the plan looks at several parts of everyday life.
sentences.zh: 北爱尔兰的人口正在老龄化，因此这项计划关注日常生活的多个方面。

sentences.text: These include better housing, help with fuel poverty and greater financial security.
sentences.zh: 其中包括改善住房、帮助应对燃料贫困，以及提高经济保障。

sentences.text: Fuel poverty means difficulty paying for enough energy to keep a home warm.
sentences.zh: 燃料贫困指难以负担让家中保持温暖所需的能源费用。

sentences.text: The strategy also aims to help older workers stay in employment for as long as they wish or need to.
sentences.zh: 该战略还旨在帮助年长劳动者按其意愿或需要继续就业。

sentences.text: Other goals include opportunities for older people to join cultural, learning and physical activities.
sentences.zh: 其他目标包括为老年人提供参加文化、学习和体育活动的机会。

sentences.text: People can give their views during the public consultation, which runs until 4 January 2027.
sentences.zh: 公众可以在公开征求意见期间发表看法，截止日期为2027年1月4日。

sentences.text: The department will hold information sessions in Craigavon, Londonderry, Enniskillen, Ballymena and Belfast.
sentences.zh: 该部门将在克雷加文、伦敦德里、恩尼斯基林、巴利米纳和贝尔法斯特举办说明会。

phrases.zh: 持续到……所希望或需要的时长
phrases.note: 本句 for as long as 表示持续的时间长度，不是一般条件“只要”。

sentences.note: aim to do 表示目标，不等于已经实现；for as long as they wish or need to 表示就业持续到劳动者所希望或需要的时长。

questions.text: What activities could help older people feel part of your community?
questions.zh: 哪些活动能帮助老年人融入你所在的社区？

questions.text: Would you rather share your views online or at an information session? Why?
questions.zh: 你更愿意在线表达意见，还是参加说明会？为什么？

expressions.text: I would like more opportunities to …
expressions.note: 原创口语表达，用来提出活动或服务需求。
